claim: An isolated git worktree has no maps/ (gitignored) and no reference/ (the ART), so corpus tests skip silently and ART-dependent rules regrade to zero. Junction those two to the main checkout; never junction NBlood or xmapedit (it breaks git status through submodule resolution), and read the engine by absolute path instead.
evidence: 2026-09-03: two of nine 'worktree failures' were only the missing reference/ junction; adding it un-skipped 27 tests. BLOODMAP_ART does not substitute (read_surfaces reads it only through read_facts.recover).
use: New-Item -ItemType Junction for maps and reference after git worktree add; unlink the junctions before removing the worktree.
